当你的3D游戏或AR/VR应用在马良GPU设备上遇到性能瓶颈，需要提升渲染画质或降低功耗时使用本Kit的超分能力
当GPU性能不足以持续为每个像素提供相同质量的渲染时，使用自适应VRS功能降低渲染开销
当需要实现高质量的光线追踪效果（如反射、阴影、环境光遮蔽、全局光照）以提升画面真实感时，应使用本Kit的光线追踪能力
当使用TBDR或Forward+渲染管线需要降低带宽开销时，应使用Subpass Shading能力
接入XEngine提升游戏渲染性能和画质 / Integrate XEngine to improve game rendering performance and visual quality
实现超分辨率渲染让低分辨率输出更清晰 / Implement super resolution rendering to make low-resolution output sharper
添加AI超采样减少性能压力同时保持清晰度 / Add AI upscaling to reduce performance cost while keeping image clarity
启用可变着色率降低复杂场景的GPU负载 / Enable variable rate shading to lower GPU load in complex scenes
实现光线追踪反射和阴影增强真实感 / Implement ray-traced reflections and shadows for more realistic visuals
为3D场景接入全局光照提升室内外光照效果 / Add global illumination to a 3D scene for better indoor and outdoor lighting
使用GPU排序加速大量粒子或透明物体排序 / Use GPU sorting to speed up sorting of many particles or transparent objects
在Forward+或TBDR渲染管线中启用Subpass Shading / Enable Subpass Shading in a Forward+ or TBDR rendering pipeline
检查当前设备是否支持超分、VRS或光追能力 / Check whether the current device supports super resolution, VRS, or ray tracing
为高帧率游戏优化渲染开销和功耗 / Optimize rendering cost and power consumption for high-frame-rate games
实现时域超分提升抗锯齿效果并稳定画面 / Implement temporal super resolution to improve anti-aliasing and stabilize the image
在GPU和NPU协同下实现更高质量的图像重建 / Implement higher-quality image reconstruction with GPU and NPU collaboration
do_not_use_when: 需求是通用2D绘制、画布、文本或基础图像渲染，而不是马良GPU上的3D渲染加速；请改用 arkgraphics-2d / The need is general 2D drawing, canvas, text, or basic image rendering rather than 3D rendering acceleration on Maleoon GPU; use arkgraphics-2d instead

需求是构建3D场景、模型、材质、相机或基础3D渲染框架，而不是启用超分、VRS、光追或GPU排序特性；请改用 arkgraphics-3d / The need is to build 3D scenes, models, materials, cameras, or a basic 3D rendering framework rather than enabling super resolution, VRS, ray tracing, or GPU sorting features; use arkgraphics-3d instead

需求是AR会话、平面识别、锚点、跟踪或AR交互能力，而不是底层GPU渲染优化；请改用 ar-engine / The need is AR sessions, plane detection, anchors, tracking, or AR interaction rather than low-level GPU rendering optimization; use ar-engine instead

需求是通用图形/媒体加速或非马良GPU专属优化，且不依赖XEngine特性集合；请改用 graphics-accelerate-kit / The need is general graphics/media acceleration or optimization not specific to Maleoon GPU, without relying on XEngine feature set; use graphics-accelerate-kit instead

需求是空间扫描、环境重建、网格/点云重建或场景理解，而不是渲染特效与图形管线优化；请改用 spatial-recon-kit / The need is spatial scanning, environment reconstruction, mesh/point-cloud reconstruction, or scene understanding rather than rendering effects and graphics pipeline optimization; use spatial-recon-kit instead
preconditions: 目标设备支持 SystemCapability.Graphic.XEngine 系统能力 / The target device supports the SystemCapability.Graphic.XEngine system capability
应用运行在使用马良GPU的受支持设备上 / The app is running on a supported device using a Maleoon GPU

已通过扩展特性查询接口确认所需具体特性受支持（如超分、VRS、Subpass Shading、光追或GPU排序） / The required specific feature support has been confirmed through the extension feature query API (such as super resolution, VRS, Subpass Shading, ray tracing, or GPU sorting)
渲染管线已采用受支持的图形API与上下文（OpenGL ES或Vulkan） / The rendering pipeline is using a supported graphics API and context (OpenGL ES or Vulkan)
inputs: 目标XEngine特性类型 / target XEngine feature type
设备能力与特性查询结果 / device capability and feature query results
渲染管线配置与图形API上下文 / rendering pipeline configuration and graphics API context
场景或帧的输入纹理、颜色附件或缓冲资源 / scene or frame input textures, color attachments, or buffer resources

postconditions.statement: 代码或说明中包含对 SystemCapability.Graphic.XEngine 或等效设备能力的支持性检查 / The code or instructions include a support check for SystemCapability.Graphic.XEngine or equivalent device capability
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the agent's edit set add or describe a concrete check that the device supports XEngine before using its APIs?

postconditions.statement: 代码或说明中包含对所需具体XEngine特性的查询或判定，而不是盲目直接启用 / The code or instructions include querying or determining the required specific XEngine feature instead of blindly enabling it
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the agent's edit set add or describe a feature-specific availability check for the requested XEngine capability such as super resolution, VRS, ray tracing, Subpass Shading, or GPU sorting?

postconditions.statement: 渲染流程已接入所请求的XEngine优化点，并限定在OpenGL ES或Vulkan路径中使用 / The rendering flow is integrated with the requested XEngine optimization point and restricted to OpenGL ES or Vulkan paths
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is the requested XEngine feature wired into a rendering path that explicitly uses or targets OpenGL ES or Vulkan?
